message:

A column cannot be assigned more than one value in the same clause. Modify the clause to make sure that a column is updated only once. If this statement updates or inserts columns into a view, column aliasing can conceal the duplication in your code. (264) (SQLExecDirectW); [42000] [Microsoft][ODBC Driver 17 for SQL Server][SQL Server]Statement(s) could not be prepared. (8180)")
[SQL: INSERT INTO [Outlets] ([Outlet_Name], [Outlet_Name]) OUTPUT INSERTED.[Outlet_ID] VALUES (?, ?)]
[parameters: (None, None)]
